content_sections.heading: About NSIL
content_sections.text: NewSpace India Limited (NSIL) is a Government of India company under the Department of Space (DOS). It was incorporated in March 2019 to provide space-related products and services and to help Indian industry grow in technologically challenging space activities. NSIL's office is at the ISRO Headquarters Campus, New BEL Road, Bengaluru-560 094. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. The post is Un-Reserved (UR). Where no reservation exists for a category, candidates from that category may apply for the unreserved post if they meet its minimum eligibility criteria. Rules on qualifications: All qualifications should be from a University/Institute recognised by the Government of India. Courses should be approved by an AICTE/UGC-approved college/Institute or a recognised University. You can apply with a qualification earned through distance learning or part-time study, as long as the relevant statutory bodies recognise it for employment to Central Government posts and services. Equivalence is decided on the equivalent certificate provided by the University/Institution. If your qualifying degree does not mention the specialisation that the essential qualification requires, you must submit a certificate from your University/Institution/College that shows the specialisation. The date the result is declared or the mark sheet is issued counts as the date you acquired the qualification, and there is no relaxation on this point. You need 16 years of post-qualification experience in Accounts and Finance. At least 2 of those years must be in the immediate lower grade/scale of IDA: 70,000 - 3% - 2,00,000, or the equivalent level in the private sector (Rs. 15 lacs p.a. CTC). Experience is preferably in a PSU, aerospace/Joint ventures of PSEs/Central Govt/State Govt/Private Sector. You should also be proficient in ERP-based accounting systems and financial software. How NSIL counts experience: Internships or project work placements that were part of your course do not count. Only paid internships done after you obtained the minimum essential qualification count as relevant post-qualification experience. One completed year of apprenticeship under the PM Internship program counts as experience. Teaching experience does not count as relevant work experience. Work done before you completed the minimum essential qualification does not count. Experience certificates or documentary evidence from your previous and present employers must clearly show the period of employment and the positions held. Experience without supporting documents will not be considered, and NSIL's decision on the relevance of experience is final. The upper age limit is 48 years as on the closing date, 25 November 2026. The cut-off date for age, minimum post-qualification experience and qualification is also 25 November 2026. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Chief Manager - Accounts & Finance post is in Grade E5, with a pay scale of Rs.80,000 - 3% - 2,20,000/- under the IDA pattern. Total Emoluments & Allowances include: Basic Pay in the pay scale Dearness Allowance House Rent Allowance (at the rates that apply at the place of posting) Cafeteria Allowance, etc. Officials can also use the Group Health Schemes that the company has adopted. The appointment is on a regular basis. You must be willing to be posted anywhere in India where NSIL has an office, and to travel across India as required.

content_sections.heading: NSIL Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The key responsibilities of the Chief Manager - Accounts & Finance are: Oversee financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis to support strategic decision-making. Ensure compliance with government financial regulations, tax laws, and statutory requirements. Coordinate with regulatory bodies such as CAG, GST authorities, and other financial auditors. Provide leadership in investment planning and risk assessment, and lead a team so that the department functions efficiently. Develop and implement financial policies, procedures, and best practices. Support management in financial decision-making through in-depth financial analysis and reports. Liaise with banks, financial institutions, and government agencies for financial transactions.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: NSIL will select through a written test and/or interview, on a schedule it will announce. Screening and selection are based on the details you give in the application form. The final selection is made in order of merit, based on your performance in the written test and/or interview. Meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not give you a right to be called for the interview. You may need to stay an additional day for the selection process. Travelling expenses/allowance for attending the written test and/or interview are paid as per the Company norms.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NSIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for Chief Manager – Accounts & Finance (Post Code CMF-01), in the UR (Un-Reserved) category.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for NSIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: You must apply online through the QR code by 25 November 2026, 6:00 PM. The hard copy must reach NSIL by 30 November 2026, 6:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the NSIL Chief Manager – Accounts & Finance post?
faq.answer: You need a Bachelor's Degree (in First Class) with a pass in the final examination of CA / ICWA from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India / Institute of Cost Accountants of India respectively. You also need 16 years of post-qualification experience, including at least 2 years in the immediate lower grade/scale.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NSIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 48 years as on the closing date, 25 November 2026. Relaxation applies to PwBDs, Ex-Servicemen and eligible J&K domiciles. SC/ST/OBC candidates applying against the UR vacancy get no relaxation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NSIL Chief Manager – Accounts & Finance?
faq.answer: The post is in Grade E5, with a pay scale of Rs.80,000 – 3% – 2,20,000/- (IDA pattern). Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Cafeteria Allowance, etc. are paid on top, along with Group Health Schemes.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for NSIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 500/- + 18% GST = Rs. 590/-, paid by Demand Draft in favour of NewSpace India limited (NSIL) drawn at Bangalore. Women / SC / ST / PWD candidates are exempted, and the fee is not refunded.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for NSIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the QR code in the notice. Then send the hard copy with the documents and Demand Draft by registered post/speed post/courier to Deputy General Manager-HR & Administration, NewSpace India Limited, 11th floor, Brigade Rubix, 20, watch Factory Road, Phase-1, Yashwanthpur, Bengaluru- 560013.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the NSIL Chief Manager post?
faq.answer: Selection is through a written test and/or interview, on a schedule NSIL will declare. The final selection is in order of merit, based on your performance in the written test and/or interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is the NSIL Chief Manager – Accounts & Finance post permanent?
faq.answer: NSIL is recruiting for this post on a regular basis. You may be posted anywhere in India where NSIL has an office.

faq.question: Q10. Do government or PSU employees need an NOC to apply to NSIL?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates working in PSUs or Government organisations must submit a No Objection Certificate at the time of application or interview. If selected, they must also submit a relieving letter at the time of joining.
